issue_context.title: Studio returns 404 when switching projects after running a log query
issue_context.body:
# Bug report

- [x] I confirm this is a bug with Supabase, not with my own application. 
- [x] I confirm I have searched the [Docs](https://docs.supabase.com), GitHub [Discussions](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/discussions), and [Discord](https://discord.supabase.com). 

## Describe the bug

If you try to switch to another project **after** running a log query, a 404 error page is displayed.

## To Reproduce

1. Go to "Logs Explorer" of some project. `https://app.supabase.com/project/<project-id>/logs/explorer`
2. Click on "Run" to execute the default "Last 24 hours" query.
3. Try to switch to another project using the toolbar menu.
4. A 404 error page is displayed because the link points to `https://app.supabase.com/project/<project-id>/logs` (missing `/explorer`)

## Expected behavior

The toolbar project switch points to the "Logs Explorer" view of each project correctly, as it does before clicking on the "Run" button.

## System information

- OS: macOS.
- Browser: Chrome.

review_comments:
nit: hard coded numbers feel brittle... if we are removing the last directory in the path, might consider:
```suggestion
      .slice(0, -1)
```

Yeah it is brittle Greg, but not sure of a way around it. The other alternative is baking logic in for just the logs explorer pages with query strings. 

Your .slice(0, -1) works but still doesn't account for when logs explorer pages have query strings:
